categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of wet wipes, face masks, and personal care products. Its wet wipe products cover six major series including baby wipes, adult functional wipes, antibacterial disinfectant wipes, household cleaning wipes, medical care wipes, and pet cleaning wipes. The company also provides OEM/ODM manufacturing services for global well-known brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses mature production technologies for wet wipes and face masks, with a strong R&D team holding multiple patents in invention, utility models, and design patents. It emphasizes proprietary solution formulation technology, packaging structure, and product functionality development. Production lines are equipped with advanced automated and intelligent equipment imported from countries like Japan, Italy, and the USA, ensuring high-quality and efficient manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global renowned companies such as Woolworths, Kimberly-Clark, Johnson & Johnson, L'Oréal, Procter & Gamble, Reckitt Benckiser, Clorox, 3M, and domestic well-known e-commerce clients like Hangzhou Baibeike and Natural Hall Group. The company serves both domestic and international markets, focusing on brand owners who outsource manufacturing under ODM/OEM models.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Tongling, Anhui Province. It has expanded its market development efforts internationally, including establishing a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States to support overseas trade and investment. Domestic sales account for approximately 52% of revenue, while international sales account for about 48%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and ODM/OEM supplier in the personal hygiene product supply chain. It focuses on product design, formulation, and manufacturing, while its customers handle branding, marketing, and distribution downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening specialization in wet wipes, enhancing product quality to maintain customer loyalty, and expanding into cosmetics and new product categories. The company invests heavily in R&D to innovate solution formulations, develop environmentally friendly and multifunctional products, and improve production processes. It also plans to strengthen organizational capabilities and explore brand building alongside its ODM/OEM business.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales and processing services under ODM/OEM contracts. The company sells wet wipes, face masks, and personal care products directly to brand owners and retailers. It also earns income from other business activities such as leasing and logistics services, though these constitute a small portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the top wet wipe manufacturers in China, holding 4th to 8th place nationally by sales volume in recent years. It competes with numerous small-scale domestic producers and well-known foreign brands that dominate the market. The company leverages its strong R&D, quality control, and customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge in the ODM/OEM segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 547 million, a 12.07% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 19.5 million, down 83.10%. The company has total assets of around RMB 2.08 billion and equity of RMB 1.83 billion. Despite recent profit declines due to market competition and reduced orders, the company continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable product delivery with a broad product range covering diverse customer needs. Its core competitive advantages include proprietary solution formulation technology, comprehensive quality management systems, and strong customization capabilities. The company also focuses on environmentally friendly materials and innovative product functions to differentiate itself in the market.
